title: CAT 2024 Question Paper (Slot 3, QA) - Quant - Combinatorics
subject: Quant

questions.q: The number of all positive integers up to 500 with non-repeating digits is:
questions.explain: 1-digit numbers: 9. 2-digit numbers: 9*9=81. 3-digit numbers (100-499): 4 choices for 1st digit (1-4). 9 for 2nd, 8 for 3rd. For numbers starting with 1,2,3,4: $4 \times 9 \times 8 = 288$. The number 500 has repeating digits. Total = 9+81+288 = 378.
